capabilities.justification: scan and copy use read_dir/symlink_metadata to enumerate bucket and object entries.
copy reads source object files (File::open, with O_NOFOLLOW on Unix) to migrate them.
copy creates target bucket directories (fs::create_dir / create_dir_all).
copy writes objects via a staging file then fs::rename into place.
copy removes a stale staging file left by an earlier interrupted migration.
open_nofollow uses libc::O_NOFOLLOW and libc::ELOOP constants on Unix to refuse symlinked source files.

justification: Scans a caller-supplied vault-pm object-store root directory for symptoms of third-party sync-tool interference (VLT-PM00 s12, s23 item 14), and copies an object root's committed files to another caller-supplied root for `storage migrate`. No network, process, environment, clock, entropy, cryptography, key, or custody authority in non-test code.
